BH3_ER_set_cand_ser = {
	set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 100 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 115 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 200 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 215 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 300 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 315 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 400 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 415 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 500 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 515 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 600 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 615 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 700 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 715 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 800 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 815 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 8 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 900 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 915 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 9 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 1000 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 1015 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 10 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 1100 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 1115 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 11 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id > 1200 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id < 1215 } }
		set_temp_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = 12 }
	}
}

BH3_ER_count_pool = {
	set_variable = { BH3_ER_pool_left = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_dlv_101 } }
		add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_pool_left = 1 }
	}

BH3_ER_update_core_ready = {
	set_variable = { BH3_ER_core_ready = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_dlv_107 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_dlv_111 }
			check_variable = { BH3_ER_norm_dlv > 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_core_ready = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_gold_207 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_gold_211 }
			check_variable = { BH3_ER_norm_gold > 2 }
		}
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_core_ready = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_country_flag = BH3_ER_own_sts_307 }

		}

BH3_ER_roll_candidates = {
	set_variable = { BH3_ER_draw_fallback = 0 }
	BH3_ER_count_pool = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_pool_left = 0 } }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = 0 }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = 0 }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_c3 = 0 }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_draw_fallback = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } } set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = 0 } set_variable = { BH3_ER_c1_ser = 0 } }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ok = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c1_ser } } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes

			if = {

				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_free = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c1_ser } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c3_ser } } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_free = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c3 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c1_ser } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c3_ser } } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } } set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = 0 } set_variable = { BH3_ER_c2_ser = 0 } }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_c3 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 0 } }
			BH3_ER_roll_one = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_free = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_id = BH3_ER_c2 } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c1_ser } } NOT = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_cand_ser = BH3_ER_c2_ser } } }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c3 = BH3_ER_cand_id }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c3_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }

				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c3_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_slot_ok = 1 }

				set_variable = { BH3_ER_c3_ser = BH3_ER_cand_ser }

		}
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_c1 = 0 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_c2 = 0 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_c3 = 0 } } } set_variable = { BH3_ER_draw_fallback = 1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_draw_fallback = 1 } } add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = 5 } }
}

BH3_ER_roll_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_draws > 0 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_offer = 0 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { BH3_ER_draws = 1 }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 0 }
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 100 }
		BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		set_variable = { BH3_ER_offer = 1 }
	}
}

BH3_ER_refresh_offer = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_offer = 1 } check_variable = { BH3_ER_draw_fallback = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 0 } }
			# 每层第一次刷新免费
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 1 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 100 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 1 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -100 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 2 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 200 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 2 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -200 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 3 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 400 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 3 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -400 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 4 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 800 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 4 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -800 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 5 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 1600 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 5 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -1600 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 6 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 3200 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 6 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -3200 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 7 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 6400 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 7 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -6400 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 8 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 12800 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 8 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -12800 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 9 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 25600 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 9 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -25600 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 10 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 51200 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 10 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -51200 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 11 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 102400 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 11 } }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -102400 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 12 }
			set_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 204800 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
		else = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = BH3_FlawlessKey_equipment amount = -204800 }
			add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_count = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { BH3_ER_refresh_cost = 2 }
			BH3_ER_roll_candidates = yes
		}
	}
}

# Shop refresh：消耗空梦之币刷新商店，初始 100，每次翻倍（3000 币上限 → 实际最多约 4~5 次）
BH3_ER_shop_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { BH3_ER_can_shop_refresh = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_count = 0 } }
				add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_rv_coin = -100 }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_count = 1 }
				set_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_cost = 200 }
				# TODO(shop): 商店补货逻辑在此处调用
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_count = 1 } }
				add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_rv_coin = -200 }

			}
			else = {
				add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_rv_coin = -204800 }
				add_to_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_count = 1 }
				multiply_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_cost = 2 }
			}
		}
}

BH3_ER_shop_refresh_reset = {
	set_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { BH3_ER_shop_refresh_cost = 100 }
}
